explanation: Only at D1 does it rise above 0. It fires when the previous trial chose a1, went commonly to S1 and got no reward: about 10 after a run of rewarded a1 trials (more like 5-8 late in the episode or right after another miss), about 4 if the trial before that was also a miss, about 1 if an a2 choice rarely reached S1 unrewarded, and 0 at every GO and D2, after any rewarded trial, and after any unrewarded trial that ended in S2.
